script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

---

FADE IN:

EXT. SMALL TOWN - DAY

Wide shot of a quaint small town with colorful houses, a church steeple, and people walking on the sidewalks. Birds are chirping in the trees.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
(softly)
In a small town nestled between rolling hills and a sparkling lake, life was simple. But when an unexpected event turned the tranquil town upside down, the people of Meadowbrook would discover that sometimes, simple isn't always easy.

INT. MC'S KITCHEN - DAY

Interior of a warm, sunlit kitchen. MRS. MC (50s, warm, kind) is cooking breakfast for her husband, MR. MC (60s, gentle, loving). They share small talk as they eat.

MR. MC
(smiling)
You know, honey, I can't remember the last time we had a day off together.

MRS. MC
(laughing)
I know, dear. But now that the kids are grown and out of the house, it's nice to have some quiet time.

MR. MC
Agreed. And speaking of the kids, have you talked to Sarah lately?

MRS. MC
(pauses)
I have. She's having a hard time adjusting to her new job in the city.

MR. MC
(sighs)
That's too bad. But she'll figure it out.

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

Ms. MILLER (70s, wise, observant), the librarian, helps SARAH (20s, anxious, unsure) find a book.

SARAH
(looking frustrated)
I don't know what I'm in the mood for, Ms. Miller. Something light, maybe?

MS. MILLER
(smiling)
How about a classic love story? It never hurts to remind ourselves of the power of human connection.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CLASSROOM - DAY

Young TEACHER (early 30s, passionate, dedicated) is teaching a literature class. JIMMY (16, quiet, thoughtful), a student, raises his hand.

TEACHER
(encouraging)
Yes, Jimmy?

JIMMY
(softly)
Ms. Thompson, do you believe in fate?

TEACHER
(pauses)
Well, Jimmy, some people do. They believe that certain events are meant to be and that our paths are predetermined.

INT. MC'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Mr. and Mrs. Mc are lying in bed, gazing at the stars.

MR. MC
(looking at his wife)
You know, honey, I've been thinking. Maybe we should adopt a child.

MRS. MC
(surprised)
Really? I thought you wanted to retire and travel.

MR. MC
I do. But I also want to give back to our community. And I believe that a child needs a loving home more than anything.

INT. SARAH'S APARTMENT - DAY

Sarah is on the phone, crying. Her mother listens and consoles her.

MRS. MC (V.O.)
(softly)
Sometimes, life can be difficult. But remember, dear, you're not alone.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

Jimmy is practicing for the upcoming track meet. He collapses from exhaustion but is helped up by a fellow student, OLIVIA (16, kind, strong).

OLIVIA
(concerned)
Are you okay? You don't look good.

JIMMY
(weakly)
I'm fine. Just tired.

OLIVIA
(smiling)
Well, if you ever need anything, just ask.

INT. MC'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Mr. and Mrs. Mc are hosting a meeting for potential adoptive parents. They share their story and their open hearts.

INT. COURTHOUSE - DAY

The Mc family is at the courthouse for the adoption hearing. They are filled with joy and anticipation.

JUDGE
(smiling)
Congratulations, Mr. and Mrs. Mc. You have been selected as the adoptive parents of baby Samantha.

The room erupts in applause and tears of joy.

INT. MC'S KITCHEN - DAY

Several weeks later, Mrs. Mc is baking cookies as the front door opens. In walks Sarah, who looks more relaxed and content.

SARAH
(smiling)
Mom! I got a new job, and it's closer to home.

MRS. MC
(surprised and pleased)
Really? That's wonderful news!

INT. HIGH SCHOOL TRACK FIELD - DAY

Jimmy and Olivia stand together, watching the other runners. Jimmy puts his arm around her shoulders.

OLIVIA
(looking at him)
You're a good person, Jimmy. You deserve to be happy.

JIMMY
(smiling)
And you, Olivia. You deserve the world.

They share a moment, and the sun sets behind them.

FADE OUT.

THE END
